title: Gopher-backed sphere checking
summary: sphere.check resolves named spheres through LLM Gopher v0.21-dev1, while v0.2-dev7 also projects those sphere archives into first-class project components for ownership and request coordination.
invariants: Sphere identifiers are restricted before shell invocation.
A missing sphere is an application tool error, not a transport parse error.
Sphere knowledge authority remains separate from executable/runtime authority.
A supplied sphere componentId must name the same sphereId or resolution fails closed.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
